question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginis?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation are named together as aims.
Great accomplishment is the stated attainment.
Becoming dear to the yoginis is the resulting status.
inference: One who attains the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginis.
plain_english: He may attain the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation and become dear to the yoginis.
